result.title: Uber rolls out ChatGPT Work to 30,000+ employees
result.description:
Following a 1,000-person pilot, Uber is bringing ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees worldwide in its first company-wide deployment of an agentic platform for knowledge work.

Uber CTO Praveen Neppalli Naga and OpenAI co-founder and President Greg Brockman discuss expanding AI beyond engineering and helping teams rethink entire workflows.

Read more about Uber’s rollout of ChatGPT Work: https://openai.com/index/uber-chatgpt-work-rollout/

result.title: Build a Better Shopping Experience with OpenAI | Shopping Agent Demo
result.description:
See how an AI shopping agent can turn a room photo into a personalized shopping experience—from finding the right products to updating an order.

In this demo for fictional home goods retailer Vesper & Alder, a shopper uses voice and images to create a cozy reading nook. The agent recommends products, generates a preview of the room, adjusts selections to fit a $250 budget, and suggests a complementary throw blanket. After checkout, it helps switch the order from store pickup to home delivery—all through conversation.

This demo brings together two OpenAI models:
GPT-Live-1 powers natural voice conversations to help shoppers find what they’re looking for.
GPT-Images-2.6 creates and edits images to preview furniture in photos of shoppers’ own rooms.

Explore what you can build with OpenAI: https://openai.com/solutions/industries/retail/
